mobbin:9b6a37a7-8bbf-4883-a999-463f46cfb.summary: Manager opens an empty department/role week grid, then a populated schedule showing Conflicts/Overtime pills, per-row OT totals, cell lightning bolts, Open Shifts rows, Import/Publish, and a Budget Tool footer.
steps: Empty week — Dept/Role/Open Shifts rows + Import
Populated week — OT on Leonard + Open Finance shift
Warnings bar — 2 Conflicts / 2 Overtime + Fix warnings
Optimal Labor promo overlay on schedule
Grid — red OT cells + TIME OFF + Budget Tool
steal: Header pills: Conflicts + Overtime + Fix warnings jump (steps 3, 5).
Hierarchy: Department → Role → Open Shifts row → people (steps 1–2, 5).
Per-row hours/cost plus red Total OT; cell lightning + Overtime label (steps 2, 5).
Import first schedule + Publish schedule in same toolbar (steps 1, 3).
avoid: POS Optimal Labor promo overlay covering the grid mid-flow (step 4) — blocks scheduling work.
mobbin:9b6a37a7-8bbf-4883-a999-463f46cfb.fit: Best conflict/OT-on-resource-grid reference for room/faculty double-book and contact-hour warnings; Import CTA aligns with Excel master-file direction.

mobbin:5b627af5-e4b7-47ec-8d86-154da7cdb.summary: From the week grid with Conflicts/OT visible, manager opens Open Shifts side panel, sets role/time/notes, checks Offer to everyone, multi-selects Apply to days, and returns to a grid where Open Shifts rows hold unassigned slots.
steps: Week grid — Conflicts/OT + Open Shifts rows
Week grid — hover + on Open Shifts cells
Open Shifts panel — role, times, Offer everyone, Apply Sat
Open Shifts panel — Offer + notes filled
Grid after create — Open Shifts row + warnings remain
steal: Dedicated Open Shifts row per department for unassigned capacity (steps 1–2, 6).
Open Shifts form: role, duration auto-calc, Offer to everyone at all locations (steps 3–5).
Apply to Mon–Sun day chips for multi-day slot creation (steps 3–5).
Conflicts/OT stay visible while creating open slots (steps 1–6).
mobbin:5b627af5-e4b7-47ec-8d86-154da7cdb.fit: Self-sign-up / unassigned session slots for rotations: create open cells then claim; cheaper than full roster auto-gen when only gaps need filling.
